rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO): allowable annual rent increase
rules.requirement: Rent in covered units may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage published by LAHD. Increases above that percentage need LAHD approval (capital improvement, primary renovation, seismic retrofit, rehabilitation, just and reasonable rent increase). Rent may go to market rate after a voluntary move-out, certain evictions or a tenant buyout agreement. Effective Feb 2, 2026, the extra utility percentage and the extra 10% for an added dependent are no longer permitted. A 10% increase for an additional non-dependent tenant is allowed if the landlord acts within 60 days of learning of that tenant. Rent increases were prohibited from Mar 30, 2020 through Jan 31, 2024.
rules.key_value: Once per 12 months by the allowable percentage (set by LAHD PDF, no figure in text); +10% for additional non-dependent tenant within 60 days; no utility or dependent add-on from 2026-02-02; $3.00 smoke detector surcharge; registration surcharge $1.61/month

unverifiable_exemptions: Luxury exemption (landlord must establish monthly rent charged on or before May 31, 1978)
coverage.summary: Rental properties first built on or before October 1, 1978, plus replacement units under LAMC 151.28. Covers apartments, duplexes, two or more single-family units on one parcel, hotel/rooming house rooms occupied over 30 consecutive days, residential units attached to commercial buildings, ADUs, JADUs, and mobile homes/RVs in mobile home parks. Condominiums and townhomes are covered, but rent is not regulated for tenancies that commenced after Dec 31, 1995.
coverage.other_conditions: Condominium and townhome rent not regulated for tenancies commenced after December 31, 1995.

rules.exemptions: Luxury exemption available on application; temporary exemptions; condos and townhomes with tenancies commenced after 12/31/1995 not rent regulated.
rules.effective_date_note: The page gives Feb 2, 2026 as the date the utility and dependent add-ons ended. The RSO's original start date is not stated.
rules.quoted_span: Rent may be increased once every 12 months by the allowable rent increase percentage
rules.review_note: The document does not give the section number for the rent increase provision. The citation uses the only RSO section it names for coverage (LAMC 151.28). The allowable percentage appears only in a linked PDF.
rules.source_notes: Official LAHD overview page, last modified Sept 22, 2026.

rules.title: Los Angeles RSO: legal reasons for eviction, notices and relocation assistance
rules.requirement: Evictions from RSO units are allowed only for listed at-fault reasons (nonpayment, lease violation, nuisance or damage, illegal use, failure to renew a similar agreement, no reasonable access, unapproved subtenant) or no-fault reasons (owner or family move-in, resident manager, demolition and permanent removal, government order, conversion to affordable housing). Every notice to terminate a tenancy must be filed with LAHD within 3 business days of service. For no-fault evictions the landlord must file a Landlord Declaration of Intent to Evict, give 30-day and 60-day written notice (some require 120 days or up to a 1-year extension), and pay tenant relocation assistance. Since Aug 20, 2025 the Notice of Right to Counsel must be posted, given at the start of tenancy, and attached to any eviction notice or termination of a rental subsidy.
rules.key_value: Notice filed with LAHD within 3 business days of service; 30-day and 60-day written notice (120 days or 1-year extension for some); relocation assistance for no-fault evictions; Right to Counsel notice attached to eviction notices from 2025-08-20

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units subject to the RSO (first built on or before Oct 1, 1978, plus replacement units). Non-RSO properties fall under the separate Just Cause Ordinance, which the page does not describe.

rules.effective_date_note: The RSO eviction provisions' original effective date is not stated. The Right to Counsel notice requirement began Aug 20, 2025.
rules.quoted_span: Give the tenant a 30-day and 60-day written notice (some evictions require 120-day notice or up to a 1-year extension).
rules.review_note: Relocation assistance amounts are not stated. Relocation is folded into this record because the page gives no separate code section for it.
rules.source_notes: Official LAHD overview page. The page cites LAMC 151.09.C.9 and 165.05.B.5 for the 3-business-day filing requirement.

result.doc_summary: LAHD's RSO overview page (last modified Sept 22, 2026) describes Los Angeles's Rent Stabilization Ordinance. It covers properties first built on or before Oct 1, 1978, plus replacement units. The page explains the annual allowable rent increase and the changes effective Feb 2, 2026 that removed the utility and dependent add-ons. It also covers LAHD-approved increase programs, registration and surcharges, the at-fault and no-fault eviction reasons, the 3-business-day LAHD notice filing, relocation assistance for no-fault evictions, and the Right to Counsel notice required since Aug 20, 2025. Security deposit interest and the Just Cause Ordinance for non-RSO units are mentioned without detail.
